Enhance Your Viewing Experience with Advanced Screen Mirroring
Revolutionize how you watch your favorite content by connecting your phone to your TV with cutting-edge screen mirroring technology. Our intuitive app allows you to cast photos and videos directly from your smartphone to your TV, transforming your small screen into a vibrant, larger-than-life display. Share personal media, enjoy IPTV, and stream web videos for a truly cinematic experience right in your living room. No AirPlay to TV compatibility required!
Unlock Premium Features with Screen Mirroring PRO. This version offers a built-in IPTV player for seamless streaming of various channels and a live camera feature so you never miss important calls while enjoying your shows.

Key Features:
- Cast Photos and Videos: Effortlessly mirror screen to showcase memories on a big screen
- Professional Presentations: Display text files, PDFs, and whiteboards in your workspace
- Broad Compatibility: Seamlessly works with Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio, Fire TV, and Google Chromecast
- Real-Time Streaming: Experience smooth playback without interruptions
- User-Friendly Experience: Easy setup ensures anyone can mirror screen

Upgrade to PRO for Additional Benefits:
-Built-in IPTV Player: Access diverse channels with ease
-Live Camera Feature: Stay connected without missing calls during screen share
-Web Streaming: Enjoy online content on a larger screen effortlessly

Whether you’re presenting at work, showcasing vacation snapshots, or streaming home movies, Screen Mirroring is your go-to solution. Easily cast apps like Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and Telegram onto the big screen.

How to connect phone to TV:
- Allow device connections on your local network
- Ensure all devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network
- Open Screen Mirroring and connect your phone to a compatible TV device—such as Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio, Fire TV, or Google Chromecast—granting necessary permissions.
That’s it—effortlessly cast phone onto a large TV display. Download the app today to dive into high-quality entertainment with seamless iPhone mirroring, Miracast, and more.

Subscription Details:
Your iTunes Account will be charged upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings. Any unused trial portion is forfeited upon purchasing a premium subscription.
